malta/review.prefix: On 19 July 2024, the Council unanimously adopted draft S/2024/557 as resolution 2744, with all 15 voting in favour. The resolution replaced the 1730 delisting procedure and directed sanctions committees other than the 1267 Committee to revise their guidelines. It requested that the Secretary-General appoint a new Focal Point within three months, in consultation with the working group. Malta said the Focal Point would engage with petitioners and gather information from several sources for a report to assist sanctions committees in their deliberations and decisions. The Council expressed its intention to review the Focal Point’s mandate and work continuously. It established a consensus-based working group whose functions include reviewing the Focal Point’s twice-yearly reports.

switzerland/review.prefix: On 19 July 2024, the Council unanimously adopted draft S/2024/557 as resolution 2744, with all 15 voting in favour. The resolution replaced the 1730 delisting procedure and directed sanctions committees other than the 1267 Committee to revise their guidelines. It requested that the Secretary-General appoint a new Focal Point within three months, in consultation with the working group. Switzerland called the independent Ombudsperson mechanism for the 1267 regime an ideal model and welcomed the strengthened Focal Point as progress. The Council expressed its intention to review the Focal Point’s mandate and work continuously. It established a consensus-based working group whose functions include reviewing the Focal Point’s twice-yearly reports.
